nodes.name: debuggeradddebuggeeevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent DOM class representing a debugger event fired when a new debuggee global is added, carrying the global scope reference, pipeline ID, and worker ID of the debuggee.

nodes.name: debuggerblackboxevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerBlackboxEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for blackboxing a source script, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID and source coverage range information.

nodes.name: debuggerclearbreakpointevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for clearing a breakpoint, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and bytecode offset of the breakpoint.

nodes.name: debuggerevalevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerEvalEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for evaluating code in a debuggee context, carrying the code string, pipeline ID, worker ID, and frame actor ID.

nodes.name: debuggerframeevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerFrameEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for listing stack frames in a pipeline, carrying the pipeline ID, start index, and frame count.

nodes.name: debuggergetenvironmentevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for retrieving the environment of a stack frame, carrying the frame actor ID.

nodes.name: debuggergetpossiblebreakpointsevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for querying possible breakpoint locations in a script, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID.

nodes.name: debuggerglobalscope.rs
nodes.summary: Core debugger global scope that manages the Firefox DevTools protocol integration, dispatching debugger events (add/remove debuggee, eval, breakpoints, frames, blackboxing) and coordinating pause/respond cycles via channels to the devtools server.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends GlobalScope with channel-based IPC to the devtools thread for pause-and-respond debugger loops.

nodes.name: debuggerinterruptevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerInterruptEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for interrupting script execution, carrying no additional payload beyond the event itself.

nodes.name: debuggerresumeevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerResumeEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for resuming execution after a pause, carrying an optional resume limit type and frame actor ID.

nodes.name: debuggersetbreakpointevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for setting a breakpoint, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and bytecode offset.

nodes.name: debuggerunblackboxevent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DebuggerUnblackboxEvent DOM class representing a debugger event for unblackboxing a source script, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID and source coverage range information.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module file that re-exports all debugger submodules including event types, the debugger global scope, and the pipeline ID wrapper for the Firefox DevTools debugger integration.

nodes.name: pipelineid.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PipelineId DOM wrapper class that exposes a pipeline's namespace ID and index to JavaScript for the debugger's frame and source tracking.

nodes.name: DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when a new debuggee is added, wrapping the debuggee global, pipeline ID, and worker ID for delivery to debugger listeners.

nodes.name: DebuggerBlackboxEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when a source script is blackboxed, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID and source coverage start/end positions.

nodes.name: DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when a breakpoint is cleared, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and bytecode offset of the removed breakpoint.

nodes.name: DebuggerEvalEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when the debugger evaluates code in a debuggee context, carrying the code string, pipeline ID, worker ID, and frame actor ID.

nodes.name: DebuggerFrameEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when listing stack frames for a pipeline, carrying the pipeline ID, start offset, and frame count for pagination.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when retrieving a stack frame's environment, carrying the frame actor ID for lookup.

nodes.name: DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when querying possible breakpoint locations in a script, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID.

nodes.name: DebuggerGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Extends GlobalScope to provide the debugger execution environment with channel-based communication to the devtools thread, dispatching debugger events and managing the pause-and-respond debugger loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses result-sender channels (Option<Sender>) for one-shot async responses to devtools queries.

nodes.name: DebuggerInterruptEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when script execution is interrupted by the debugger, serving as a signal with no additional payload.

nodes.name: DebuggerResumeEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when execution resumes after a debugger pause, carrying an optional resume limit type and frame actor ID for targeted resumption.

nodes.name: DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when setting a breakpoint, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and bytecode offset of the breakpoint location.

nodes.name: DebuggerUnblackboxEvent
nodes.summary: DOM event dispatched when a blackboxed source script is unblackboxed, carrying the SpiderMonkey script ID and source coverage start/end positions.

nodes.name: PipelineId
nodes.summary: DOM wrapper for the internal pipeline ID type, exposing namespace ID and index properties to JavaScript for debugger frame and source tracking.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent with the debugger global, wrapped global scope, pipeline ID, worker ID, and initializes the underlying DOM event with type 'addDebuggee'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerBlackboxEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID and coverage range, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'blackbox'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and offset, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'clearBreakpoint'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerEvalEvent with the code string, pipeline ID, worker ID, and frame actor ID, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'eval'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerFrameEvent with the pipeline ID, start offset, and frame count, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'frames'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent with the frame actor ID, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'getEnvironment'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'getPossibleBreakpoints'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the DebuggerGlobalScope with devtools IPC channels, resource/storage threads, initializes the debugger realm, and defines all exposed WebIDL interfaces.

nodes.name: as_global_scope
nodes.summary: Upcasts the debugger global scope to the base GlobalScope type for accessing inherited methods.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Loads and evaluates the DebuggerJS resource script in the debugger realm to initialize the JavaScript-side debugger infrastructure.

nodes.name: fire_add_debuggee
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerAddDebuggeeEvent with the debuggee global, pipeline ID, and optional worker ID, sending the serialized event data to the devtools channel.

nodes.name: fire_eval
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerEvalEvent with the code string and context identifiers, storing the result sender for later population when the eval completes.

nodes.name: fire_get_possible_breakpoints
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerGetPossibleBreakpointsEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID, storing a result sender for the breakpoint location results.

nodes.name: fire_set_breakpoint
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent with the script ID and bytecode offset for the breakpoint location.

nodes.name: fire_interrupt
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerInterruptEvent to signal that script execution should be interrupted by the debugger.

nodes.name: fire_list_frames
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerFrameEvent with pipeline ID, start offset, and count for paginated stack frame listing, storing a result sender for the frame actor list.

nodes.name: fire_get_environment
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerGetEnvironmentEvent with the frame actor ID, storing a result sender for the environment data.

nodes.name: fire_resume
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerResumeEvent with optional resume limit type and frame actor ID to resume execution after a debugger pause.

nodes.name: fire_clear_breakpoint
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerClearBreakpointEvent with the script ID and bytecode offset to remove a breakpoint.

nodes.name: fire_blackbox
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerBlackboxEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID and coverage flag to blackbox a source script from debugger stepping.

nodes.name: fire_unblackbox
nodes.summary: Dispatches a DebuggerUnblackboxEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID and coverage flag to remove a source script from the blackbox list.

nodes.name: NotifyNewSource
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey JSAPI callback invoked when a new script source is loaded, parsing the URL, introduction type, and worker ID, then sending a CreateSourceActor message to the devtools thread.

nodes.name: GetPossibleBreakpointsResult
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey callback that receives the possible breakpoints result from JS and sends the mapped recommended breakpoint locations through the stored result sender channel.

nodes.name: EvalResult
nodes.summary: SpiderMonkey callback that receives an eval result from JS, deserializes it as a DebuggerValue (or wraps string fallback), captures exception info, and sends the result through the stored sender channel.

nodes.name: PauseAndRespond
nodes.summary: Pauses script execution by sending a DebuggerPause message to the devtools thread, then enters the pause loop to wait for resume commands from the debugger UI.

nodes.name: RegisterFrameActor
nodes.summary: Registers a stack frame actor with the devtools thread by deserializing the frame's this-value, display name, type, and URL, sending a CreateFrameActor message and awaiting the assigned actor ID.

nodes.name: RegisterEnvironmentActor
nodes.summary: Registers an environment actor with the devtools thread by deserializing bindings and optional object data, then sending a CreateEnvironmentActor message and awaiting the assigned actor ID.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerInterruptEvent, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'interrupt'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerResumeEvent with optional resume limit type and frame actor ID, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'resume'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerSetBreakpointEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID, script ID, and offset, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'setBreakpoint'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DebuggerUnblackboxEvent with the SpiderMonkey script ID and coverage range, initializing the underlying DOM event with type 'unblackbox'.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PipelineId DOM wrapper from a global scope and internal pipeline ID, initializing the reflector and wrapping the inner pipeline ID value.
